name: 18901 · Doylestown, PA
findings: ZIP 18901 (Doylestown) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 18901 (Doylestown) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
